metadata.source: Manual curation from news, product announcements, regulatory filings
metadata.note: Edit layer statuses and add events. Push to trigger rebuild.

layers.name: Hold
layers.threshold: 3+ top-25 US banks offer USDC accounts
layers.evidence: GENIUS Act signed July 2025. FDIC proposed rulemaking for bank-issued stablecoins Feb 2026. Crypto-native platforms (Coinbase, Anchorage) offer custody. Traditional banks not yet live with consumer stablecoin accounts.

layers.name: Earn
layers.threshold: Major payroll platform offers stablecoin disbursement
layers.evidence: Deel offers USDC payroll for international contractors. Request Finance enables crypto payroll. No major US payroll platform (ADP, Gusto) offers it to domestic W-2 employees yet.

layers.name: Spend
layers.threshold: Top-20 US retailer accepts stablecoin natively
layers.evidence: Stripe re-enabled stablecoin payments Oct 2024. Shopify accepts USDC via plugins. Visa settling with USDC on Solana. No major retailer accepts directly without payment processor conversion.

layers.name: Borrow
layers.threshold: Bank treats USDC as USD-equivalent collateral
layers.evidence: DeFi lending (Aave, Compound) treats stablecoins as near-equivalent. No US bank offers USD-equivalent lending against stablecoin collateral.

layers.name: Invisible
layers.threshold: Consumer surveys show <50% know which currency they used
layers.evidence: No evidence of abstraction. Users always know whether they are using stablecoins vs. USD.

canary.name: Payroll
canary.description: When a major US payroll platform allows employers to pay in stablecoins and employees to spend without converting, the off-ramp has started dissolving.

secondary_canaries.name: Tax equivalence
secondary_canaries.signal: IRS treats regulated stablecoins as cash equivalents

secondary_canaries.name: 1% of ACH
secondary_canaries.signal: Commercial payment rail competition is real

secondary_canaries.name: Top-25 bank custody
secondary_canaries.signal: Traditional financial system has absorbed stablecoins

events.event: Visa begins settling with USDC on Solana
Stripe re-enables crypto payments, adds USDC on multiple chains
US election results signal pro-crypto regulatory shift
OCC confirms national banks can custody stablecoins
Deel launches USDC payroll for US contractors
GENIUS Act signed into law by President
Shopify natively integrates USDC checkout for US merchants
JPMorgan announces stablecoin custody pilot for institutional clients
Square enables USDC acceptance at point of sale terminals
FDIC issues proposed rulemaking for bank-issued stablecoins
Rippling announces stablecoin payroll beta for US companies
DTCC partners with Digital Asset to tokenize DTC-custodied U.S. Treasury securities on Canton Network (privacy-focused permissioned chain)

Executive Order 'Integrating Financial Technology Innovation into Regulatory Frameworks' directs federal financial regulators (CFPB, SEC, NCUA, CFTC, FDIC, OCC) and the Federal Reserve to remove fragmented fintech regulations; defines 'fintech firm' to include digital-asset and blockchain-based services; orders a 120-day Fed evaluation of Reserve Bank payment-account access for non-bank digital-asset firms, with transparent application procedures and 90-day determination timelines

Federal Reserve requests public comment on a proposed limited-purpose 'payment account' for clearing and settling payments (no intraday credit, no discount window, no interest, automated overdraft controls), aimed at institutions with a wide range of business models that currently lack direct Fed access; states it would NOT change legal eligibility for accounts or payment services. 60-day comment period; Reserve Banks pausing Tier 3 access decisions pending the policy process
DTCC selects Stellar as first public blockchain in multi-chain tokenization strategy; July 2026 pilots, early 2027 rollout for Russell 1000 stocks, ETFs, U.S. Treasuries
